0022600130.text: The San Antonio Spurs host the Sacramento Kings in the Spurs' fourth game of the 2026-27 season, with San Antonio at 1-2 and 3rd in the Southwest, 2 games back, while Sacramento is 0-2 and 4th in the Pacific, 2 games back. San Antonio is without Jayden Quaintance (knee, surgery) and Tobias Harris (calf strain), and Sacramento is without Ben Simmons (Achilles, surgery), Dylan Cardwell (calf strain), and Maxime Raynaud (dislocated knee). The teams have not met yet this season, but the Spurs won all three meetings in 2025-26, most recently 132-104 in Sacramento on March 17, 2026.
